race.description: Unox Casa Lawson Poole Plate Hcp (Bm80)
race.comment: Siding with CELSIUS STAR (2) here given the likely map. He's racing very well without winning this time in, beaten by Ndola first up in the Apache Cat Classic here first up. That horse is a key chance in The Meteorite later. He'll be up on speed and hard to run down. STOLI BOLLI (1) resumes. He's a talented horse around this level and goes well fresh. He'll need a bit of luck getting back from a low gate. ALERO (8) has won 2/3 this time in and will kick up from a low gate. Bit harder here but can go on with it. ELOUYOU (3) resumes. He has the peaks to challenge, especially if it's genuinely soft ground.
